events.strDescriptionEN: UFC 332 heads to Salt Lake City with the vacant UFC women’s flyweight championship on the line as Natalia Silva faces Wang Cong in the main event at Delta Center. Silva enters as the division’s No. 1 contender on a 14-fight winning streak, having strengthened her title case with victories over former champions Rose Namajunas, Alexa Grasso and Jessica Andrade. Wang, ranked No. 8, arrives with four consecutive UFC wins and the opportunity to complete a rapid rise to the top of the division. With Valentina Shevchenko unavailable for an extended period, the matchup will crown a new undisputed champion, while the co-main event between former flyweight champion Deiveson Figueiredo and rising bantamweight contender Payton Talbott adds further intrigue to a card built around established names and emerging talent.
